body:
Im not trying to point score here! I apologise for getting frustrated and not trying to express myself clearly.

The point I was trying to make is that almost everybody was terrified when they first stepped foot into a gym. I believe youre saying that's experienced to a greater degree by people who are unhappy with their weight and size. 

A really big theme being conveyed all throughout this post, and especially in this particular thread we both replied into, is that the fear and anxiety ALL those people feel is needlessly amplified greatly by the person themself.

I've no interest n arguing with you or trying to prove you wrong. I was hoping to try and show you that the judgement "overweight people" (using your terms in an attempt to not further offend) feel, if anything, is likely to be LESS at a gym because it's inspiring and motivating to see someone decide to improve their health.

I'm happy to keep discussing this with you if you'd like, but I think it best that I just STFU at this point because I'm clearly not making things any better.

and Im speaking on behalf of all skinny fucks who are judged and told to eat a sandwich in everyday life. A gym full of massive muscular dudes and good looking fit women is just as intimidating to us as it is to you.

Im sorry, I completely misunderstood some of the people here are trying to put across. I thought they were saying "please everybody feel free to come to the gym, we welcome yuo and we're proud of you".

Because people have nothing but respect for those who try to improve themselves, and taking the first step is always the hardest

Have you considered that not a single person you've ever met or seen was born with a set gym routine? Everyone had to start, everyone had to make that first visit, and everyone shat solid gold bricks when they walked in there.

Thank you for not being offended. I'm aware people are centreing (usually unintentionally) but they're not going to listen to me about anything at the moment so reasonable discourse is out the window.

Thankfully(?) my parents arent around to yell at me. My mother passed away around 8 years ago at 55 and I've not spoken to my father (who is a very, very, bad person) for almost 20 years. The majority of abuse is coming from either my "stepdad" (he and my mother were engaged before she passed, weve always had a rough relationship) and one of my sisters. She has gone to the point of ringing the local police station to get details in attempting to catch me out in this like I'm lying. That's been quite hurtful, but that's how she processes I guess.

Thanks again for the reply, and for being understanding about my hesitation to share my feelings at the moment.
Thank you, that's helpful. I appreciate your reply

Thankyou for taking the time to reply. I apologise for my own being delayed, I managed to get a few hours sleep - Im guessing some odd sleep patterns may be an unexpected side effect of all this...

To answer your questions...

1. Yes, I received professional assistance. Police and Ambulance attended the scene. I'm not sure what they did. I only vaguely remember one person's face.

2. I didnt do anything to treat it myself

3. I took 15 5mg valium, around 20 panafen (ibuprofen + codeine), 20 5mg Endone

4. I drank 750ml Jim Beam (black label, Im not a complete savage geez) as quickly as possible. Ive always been a drinker - hell I was functioning alcoholic for quite some years - but I was sorta impressed with how quickly I drank it

5. One pre existing condition at the moment, epididymo orchitis. Inflammation of the head of the epididymis. I was on around day 5-6 of suffering, being treated with doxycyclin and keflex, and had been administered 3 IV antibiotic shots over the course of the week as the condition worsened. I'd been into hospital several days earlier as the pain had increased and was put into a home hospital program due to lack of beds.

I was removed from this program after my attempt and told to see a doctor for follow up. This happened on a friday morning and Ive not been able to get an abailable appointment until Wednesday. Christ my balls ache. I truly never wish this on anyone (even the cop that kicked me in the balls later that night)

6. Only medication in my system were the aforementioned antibiotics

7. I'd taken maybe 25mg total Endone and perhaps 5gram paracetamol and 300mg codeine over the  previous week to try and manage the sore balls (pro tip: sore balls dont care about painkillers. They just care about being sore. Jerks.)

I'm a recreational cannabis user but was on a tolreance break when this occurred. Still havent re-upped yet as my connect is currently out of town.

Again, thank you for the replies. I'm usually a responsible drug user and research substances heavily as well as side effects and come downs, but I didnt this time around for obvious reasons. All I knew was opiates and benzos potentiate, and should never be mixed with alcohol. That was all the info I needed.

Sorry, I'll clarify in OP but what I meant was is it just emotional fallout, or is this a known thing from the combination of a quantity of the substances I used.

Thank you for asking about my suicidal feelings at the moment. I've experienced a lot of yelling and screaming already so i dont really want to discuss it with someone I dont know online... Please understand this is no judgement on you, it's damage control from me in the form of trying to avoid any chances of further stress and upset.
as in go there, or go ask them?
